data.title: Kitchen installation appointment confirmed for 19 September 2026
data.summary: Küchenwerkstatt Beispielholz GmbH confirms that your new kitchen has arrived and that their assembly team will install it on Saturday, 19 September 2026 at 07:30, expected to take the whole day. You are asked to empty the kitchen beforehand, make the water and electricity connections accessible, and let them know by the Wednesday of that week if the date does not suit you.
data.explanation: This letter from your kitchen fitter sets the installation date and asks you to prepare the space in advance (empty it out, keep water/electricity connections reachable). Both the appointment (19 September 2026) and the reporting deadline it mentions (the Wednesday of that same week) have already passed relative to today, so this record is now mainly for your files. If the installation did not take place as planned, you may want to contact the company directly to arrange a new date. No payment or legal remedy is involved in this letter.
